name: focuspod
description: Distraction-free public-domain audiobook listening with an iPod-style UI and focus sessions.
//: mobile/ is intentionally NOT a workspace: npm hoisting and Metro's resolver conflict, and the RN app's node_modules is already pinned to a working set. mobile resolves @focuspod/core through a Metro alias + watchFolder instead.

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @focuspod/core && npm run typecheck --workspace @focuspod/web
